STATUS: CONFLICT
The vendor documentation gives QD < 2.0 as the active hard-filter threshold for SNPs [CF-QD:default]. A local SOP / clinic protocol uses QD < 1.5 as an alternative, which is not the vendor default [CF-QD:local]. The source status is marked decision pending (V3). The general description of hard filtering with pre-defined annotation thresholds is in [sarek_vc_theory#h008].
